participant_1.name: Rachel
participant_1.personality: Dedicated and hardworking, Rachel takes pride in her work both in the garden and as a stunt double. She is introspective, enjoys reading, and has a strong sense of responsibility.
participant_1.background: i only eat kosher. i read twenty books a year. i was raised in a single parent household. i never broke a bone in my body ever in my life. i'm a stunt double as my second job.
